_comment: V2 Phase 1B (BL-021, docs/v2/10-BACKLOG.md). Union of every role string actually observed in live data/entities/*.json (2026-08-14, all 162 entities) and the 16-role vocabulary data/imports/blueberry-public-pilot-2026-08-03/proposed-schema-enhancements.md's P-9 proposed. 'source' is live_data (observed in data/, not in P-9), blueberry_proposal_p9 (in P-9, not yet observed live), or both. This is a controlled vocabulary in the sense of 'everything currently in use, named once, in one place' -- it does NOT resolve the overlaps documented in unresolved_synonym_candidates below; per BL-021's explicit instruction, those are documented rather than silently collapsed. Live usage spans every entity type (patents, varieties, geographies, traits), not just companies, which is broader than P-9's own scope (P-9 was written with company-type entities specifically in mind, per its own text) -- worth noting for whoever eventually tightens this into an enforced enum.

unresolved_synonym_candidates.note: P-9's own noted reconciliation target -- 'currently mean the same thing under two names' (proposed-schema-enhancements.md P-9, verbatim). Not merged here.

The wider genetics_* cluster P-9's own note didn't cover. Several of these look like they encode a licensing-chain position (owner vs. licensor vs. sub-licensor vs. licensee) that may be a real, worth-keeping distinction rather than pure duplication -- flagged for a human to review with real cases in hand, not resolved here.

university_breeding_program (P-9) has 0 live uses; the closest live equivalents are private_breeding_program (8) and public_breeding_program (1), which may already cover the same distinction P-9 intended under different names.
grower_shipper and cooperative (both P-9) have 0 live uses; live data instead uses plain grower (6) and the more specific grower_cooperative (1).

license_administrator (P-9, 0 live uses) may already be covered by licensing_body (2) and/or genetics_sub_licensor (3) -- the new administers_license_for relationship predicate (relationship-predicates.json) may make some of this role-level distinction redundant at the relationship level instead.

research_institution (P-9, 0 live uses) vs. public_research_institution (2, live) -- live data specified 'public' where P-9 didn't; unclear whether a private-research-institution case exists that would need the unqualified P-9 term.

branded_berry_company (P-9, 0 live uses) vs. three different live brand-related roles (consumer_brand 7, umbrella_brand 1, brand_owner 1) -- P-9's single proposed term does not obviously map to any one of these three, or may have been intended to cover all of them.

retailer (both P-9 and live, 1 use) vs. three more specific live-only variants -- retailer is also a core entity_type (entity-types.json), so 'retailer' as a role on a non-retailer-type entity (e.g. a company that supplies retailers) vs. 'retailer' as the entity's own type is a distinction worth keeping visible.

Three granularities of the same concept, all live, none in P-9 -- likely a genuine, worth-keeping specificity gradient rather than duplication, included here rather than in a 'probably redundant' framing.

Five related but distinct live-only roles describing different positions around a branded-variety-platform structure (docs/v2/03-DOMAIN-MODEL.md's Recommendation section notes this exact market pattern, 'Breeding programmes becoming consumer platforms', from the same blueberry research). Not in P-9 at all -- P-9 predates this observation. Kept distinct pending a human review of whether all five are load-bearing.
